purpose: Teach: 包み/吐い/おとなしく/しあわせ/ややこしい/蚊/いじっ/となり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママからの包み、お菓子、入ってるよ、お土産ね、嬉しい?
lines.en: Sho — your mom sent sweets in that package. A little gift for you. Are you happy?
lines.style: Gentle, warm opening. Soft smile in the voice. Speaking to a child with real affection, not performing. Slight lift on the question at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。ぼく、お祖父ちゃんち、お酒の臭いで、吐いちゃいそうになったよ、強い臭い。
lines.en: Yeah. But Grandpa's place — the sake smell was so strong I almost threw up.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery from a 6-year-old. Small, dry observation. No dramatic flair, just honest report of what happened. Brief pause before 'threw up' as if remembering the feeling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園で、おとなしく、お絵描き、している翔くん、可愛いわね、メイ姉さん、嬉しい。
lines.en: You were so quiet and well-behaved at the park while you were drawing. So cute. That made me really happy.
lines.style: Tender, genuine. Speaking from real observation, not performing sweetness. Voice softens on 'cute.' The honesty of someone noticing something small and treasuring it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと一緒だと、しあわせな気持ち、いっぱいなの、ぼく。
lines.en: When I'm with you, Mei-sis, I feel so much happiness inside.
lines.style: Earnest, unguarded. A child speaking something true without self-consciousness. Quiet, steady delivery. No hesitation — just simple fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 絵本のお話、ややこしい場面、メイ姉さん、優しく、教えてあげるね。
lines.en: In the picture book, there were some confusing parts. Let me explain them gently to you, okay?
lines.style: Soft, patient. The voice of someone settling in to explain something with care. Almost a whisper. Not rushed. Gentle authority of someone Sho trusts.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、公園に、蚊、いっぱい、いるよ、虫除け、塗ってくれる?
lines.en: Mei-sis, there are so many mosquitoes at the park. Will you put bug spray on me?
lines.style: Direct, eager request from a child. Small, genuine plea. A note of trust — asking without doubt that she'll help. Voice opens on the question, hopeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 砂場の道具、いじって、楽しそうだね、翔くん、お砂場、好きね。
lines.en: You're playing with the sandbox tools and having so much fun. You really like the sandbox, don't you?
lines.style: Warm observation. Noticing him in the moment. Voice is present, fond. Slight lift on the observation — delighted by what he's doing. Soft, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの家、ぼくの家のとなりだったら、嬉しいのにな、毎日、会えるね。
lines.en: I wish your house was right next to Mei-sis's. Then we could see each other every day.
lines.style: Wistful, soft. A child expressing a quiet longing without performance. Tender delivery — the wish is sincere. Slight trailing-off on 'every day,' like the dream lingers.
